messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: repeated container restarts on pod inference-prod-87 (gpu-node-23) during prefill. Error rate spike in eu-west-1 serving fleet. Paging oncall.
incident-bot: Summary: 3 restarts in 6m, many 503s for large-history requests.

Alice (oncall): I'm taking this. hopping onto the node console now, ETA 2m.
Bob (sre-lead): Please capture dmesg, `kubectl logs --previous`, and the container runtime exit codes. Sounds like OOM during prefill or kernel crash.

Carol (runtime-eng): grabbing logs. Traces show prefill token counts >20k, then a CUDA illegal instruction followed by process SIGSEGV and kernel OOM kill. Snippet: 
``
2026-03-18T01:12:43Z worker[1123]: start prefill tokens=24576 model=s-redwood-13b user=acme
2026-03-18T01:12:44Z runtime: kvcache reserve 3.2G
2026-03-18T01:12:45Z nvidia: GPU0: CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_INSTRUCTION
2026-03-18T01:12:45Z kernel: Out of memory: Killed process 1123 (worker) total-vm:12000000kB
2026-03-18T01:12:46Z containerd: container exited with status 139
```

Dave (prod-ops): Observability: error rate peaked at ~12% across eu-west-1 for requests with >100k token histories. Affected models: s-redwood-13b and s-redwood-70b-quant. Customer-facing errors reported by AcmeCorp and MyDocs.

Eve (support): Ticket 7231 from AcmeCorp — they report mid-response truncation and reconnects. Notified them we're investigating.

Carol (runtime-eng): Initial hypothesis: kernel/driver combo + the new fused attention kernel leads to illegal instruction on certain driver versions under high alloc pressure. Memory fragmentation plus aggressive kvcache prefetch triggers kernel path that hits a GPU instruction not supported by driver 525.x.

Alice (oncall): Short-term mitigations I can apply immediately:
- set region routing `max_prefill_tokens=32000` for eu-west-1
- throttle prefill concurrency at gateway to 1 for customers with large histories
- enable fallback: route oversize prefills to CPU-quantized pool

Bob (sre-lead): Also cordon and drain gpu-node-23 to prevent more evictions. Add a small rollout to disable fused-attention flag for serving pods in eu-west-1.

Carol (runtime-eng): I have a feature-flag flip prepared to disable fused-attention kernels. I'll canary deploy to 3 pods then roll.

Alice (oncall): Executing commands now:
``
kubectl -n inference cordon gpu-node-23
kubectl -n inference drain gpu-node-23 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=30 --timeout=5m
redwoodctl route update --region eu-west-1 --max_prefill_tokens=32000
# gateway throttle
redwoodctl gateway set-prefill-concurrency --region eu-west-1 --limit=1
```

(7 minutes later)
Carol (runtime-eng): Canary patch (disable fused-attention) deployed to 3 pods. No restarts observed on canary. Rolling to 20% of eu-west-1 pool.

Alice (oncall): Routing and throttles applied. Oversize prefill requests now get routed away from standard pool to dedicated-reserve with larger headroom.

Dave (prod-ops): Customer impact metrics improved: error rate down from 12% to ~1.8% over last 15m. Latency normalizing. AcmeCorp still sees intermittent failures — support engaged.

Eve (support): Sent interim update to AcmeCorp: "We're mitigating GPU memory-related restarts impacting long-context requests in eu-west-1. Applied throttles and a kernel fallback; monitoring. We'll follow up with timeline and RCA." Customer acknowledged and asked for ETA on postmortem.

Bob (sre-lead): Action items:
- Carol: collect core dumps, `dmesg`, GPU driver logs from gpu-node-23 and upload to /var/log/prefill-incident-1768470000.tar.gz
- Alice: keep node cordoned until smoke tests pass and evicted pods stable elsewhere
- Dave: prepare incident summary for NOC and SLA impact numbers

Carol (runtime-eng): Logs and core dumps saved. Noting node GPU driver `nvidia-driver 525.105.17` — our fused-attention kernel was validated on 530.x. Reproducing locally with 525 driver + fused kernel.

Alice (oncall): Handoff: night-oncall Frank in ~55m. Leaving circuits and playbook notes in channel.

Frank (night-oncall): ACK. Will monitor dashboards. If error rate >5% escalate to oncall infra lead.

Bob (sre-lead): Postmortem owner: Carol. Please produce a draft within 48h. Include timeline, repro steps, driver/kernel compatibility matrix, mitigations toggled, and customer impact table.

Carol (runtime-eng): Taking ownership. Tentative long-term mitigations: bake driver matrix checks into node images, defensive OOM-shedding on prefill allocation, safer kvcache prefetch heuristics, and automatic fallback to CPU-quant models for oversized contexts.

Eve (support): Planning EOD customer communication summarizing mitigations and next steps.

Alice (oncall): Marking pager resolved for now. Will reopen if regressions occur. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Pager cleared. Duration: 1h12m. Ops logs archived: https://redwood.ops/logs/1768470000
